checkRuns.command:
pkill -f next; sed -i 's/^export function generateStaticParams/export const dynamicParams = false;\n\nexport function generateStaticParams/' app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx
bun run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|slug" | head
PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
for p in /books/nope /books/dracula; do curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "$p %{http_code}\n" localhost:4711$p; done
pkill -f "next"; sleep 1; pgrep -f next || echo stopped

bun run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|slug" | head
(PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/pid)
sleep 4
for p in /books/nope /books/dracula; do curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "$p %{http_code}\n" localhost:4711$p; done
kill $(cat /tmp/pid); sleep 1; ss -ltn | grep 4711 || echo stopped

sed -i '/cacheComponents/d;/partialPrefetching/d' next.config.ts
bun run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|slug|✓ Compiled"
(PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/pid)
sleep 4
for p in /books/nope /books/dracula /zzz; do curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "$p %{http_code}\n" localhost:4711$p; done
curl -s localhost:4711/books/nope | grep -o '<title>[^<]*'
kill $(cat /tmp/pid); sleep 1; ss -ltn | grep 4711 || echo stopped; bun run check | tail -3
